scope: Actual MIDP2 NoticeOnBirthDay and Util calendar algorithms. Real contact fields, Vector state, in-memory MicroEmulator RMS records, partial/corrupt reads, writes and historical errors. Only default Date construction in createCurrentDate and birthday Thread.start/sleep are captured. The actual worker runs synchronously at the launch boundary; physical scheduling and waiting are not claimed. Existing file-transfer fixture boundaries remain. Calendar behavior is compared with the original, including historical quirks; no Gregorian-calendar correction or physical-device RMS guarantee.
